title: Quantum Scrambling Born Machine
abstract: arXiv:2602.17281v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum generative modeling, where the Born rule naturally defines probability distributions through measurement of parameterized quantum states, is a promising near-term application of quantum computing. We propose a Quantum Scrambling Born Machine in which a fixed entangling unitary -- acting as a scrambling reservoir -- provides multi-qubit entanglement, while only single-qubit rotations are optimized. We consider three entangling unitaries -- a Haar random unitary and two physically realizable approximations, a finite-depth brickwork random circuit and analog time evolution under nearest-neighbor spin-chain Hamiltonians -- and show that, for the benchmark distributions and system sizes considered, once the entangler produces near-Haar-typical entanglement the model learns the target distribution with weak sensitivity to the scrambler's microscopic origin. Finally, promoting the Hamiltonian couplings to trainable parameters

translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.17281v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：量子生成建模，其中玻恩规则通过参数化量子态的测量自然定义概率分布，是量子计算近期有前景的应用。我们提出了一种量子搅乱玻恩机，其中固定的纠缠酉操作——作为搅乱储层——提供多量子比特纠缠，而仅优化单量子比特旋转。我们考虑了三种纠缠酉操作——一个Haar随机酉操作和两个物理可实现近似，即有限深度砖墙随机电路和最近邻自旋链哈密顿量下的模拟时间演化——并表明，对于所考虑的基准分布和系统尺寸，一旦纠缠器产生接近Haar典型的纠缠，模型学习目标分布时对搅乱器微观来源的敏感性较弱。最后，将哈密顿量耦合提升为可训练参数。
tldr: 本文提出了一种量子搅乱玻恩机，通过固定纠缠酉操作提供多量子比特纠缠，仅优化单量子比特旋转，并证明其对搅乱器微观来源的敏感性较低，同时可将哈密顿量耦合训练化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Quantum Scrambling Born Machine that uses fixed entangling unitaries for multi-qubit entanglement with only single-qubit rotations optimized, showing weak sensitivity to the scrambler's microscopic origin and enabling trainable Hamiltonian couplings.
